technique_name: Tell me why someone should learn Spanish?
description: Learning Spanish is a great way to flex your mental muscles. Not only does it provide a great challenge, it can also open up travel opportunities in Spanish-speaking countries, help you understand a new culture, and expand your job prospects. It can also help you better understand the history of the United States and its Spanish-speaking region.
